name: janavignanam-android
description: Capacitor Android wrapper for the JanaVignanam web client. The React app stays in NaiduBugata/janavignanam.

scripts.cap:sync: node scripts/sync-frontend.mjs && npx cap sync android && node scripts/brand-android.mjs
scripts.android:debug: npm run cap:sync && npm run gradle -- assembleDebug
scripts.android:release: npm run cap:sync && npm run gradle -- assembleRelease
